# SARIF 2.1.0 JSON Schema

`sarif-schema-2.1.0.json` is the OASIS Standard schema, vendored unmodified for tests.

- Source: https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json
- Schema id: `https://docs.oasis-open.org/sarif/sarif/v2.1.0/errata01/os/schemas/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json`
- Working copy: https://github.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec/blob/main/sarif-2.1/schema/sarif-schema-2.1.0.json
- The published file and that working copy were identical when vendored (2026-10-31).
- License: OASIS SARIF TC repository terms, https://github.com/oasis-tcs/sarif-spec/blob/main/LICENSE.md (OASIS IPR Policy, RF on RAND Terms Mode). This file is the SARIF Version 2.1.0 OASIS Standard JSON schema and is used here only to validate test output.

Do not edit the JSON. The test rewrites draft-04 meta keywords (`$schema`, and root `id` to `$id`) in memory so Ajv can compile it. The file on disk stays the official document.
